notes.title: Dark Room is ready
notes.notes:
As we promised before, Dark Room is ready for download on 15th July.

[previewyoutube=puVlXUDxvFE;full][/previewyoutube]

Dark Room is essentially an Adventure / Point & Click video game that by following the story line and visual arts is trying to attract most audience . 
You open your eyes in an unknown environment while remembering nothing! As you progress through the game and check the environments, you will find handwritten of mysterious people which tell of the past. Handwritten that reveal the great secret ...
